name: blast-radius-classify
description: Calibration harness orchestration: routes a change/defect description through judge-blast-radius and emits the CHOSEN radius as its output (each branch is a code node returning its own name). That makes the judge eval-able — an eval with an `exact` scorer measures how accurately it scopes re-testing (isolated vs. local vs. wide) against labeled changes. Pair with datasets/blast-radius-calibration.json + evals/blast-radius-calibration.json.
